english.note: For bodily pain or an ache, this is the all-purpose Cantonese noun.
This is the all-purpose spoken choice for a continuing minor pain or ache.

examples.english: My leg still has some pain.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 goek3 zung6 jau5 di1 tung3

examples.english: I still have a slight ache in my head.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 go3 tau4 zung6 jau5 siu2 siu2 tung3
